description_zh: 使对象闪烁，不断地出现和隐去
description_en: Make an object temporarily flash, alternately becoming visible and invisible.

conditions.description_zh: 检测对象当前是否处于闪烁状态中。
conditions.description_en: True if the object is currently flashing.
Triggered when the object stops flashing.

actions.description_zh: 使对象仅在一段时间内闪烁
actions.description_en: Make the object flash for a period of time.

params.desc_zh: 在持续时间内使对象可见
params.desc_en: Duration in seconds the object is visible.

params.desc_zh: 在持续时间内使对象不可见
params.desc_en: Duration in seconds the object is invisible.

params.desc_zh: 在持续时间内使对象闪烁
params.desc_en: Duration in seconds the object flashes for.

actions.display_zh: {my} 开始闪烁 (持续: [b]{2}[/b]秒, 显示: {0}秒, 隐去: {1}秒)

actions.description_zh: 停止闪烁并使对象可见
actions.description_en: Stop the flashing and set the object visible.
